title: Challenging the appearance of machine intelligence: Cognitive bias in LLMs and best practices for workplace adoption

bias_targets.methodology: Administering classic cognitive psychology reasoning problems (e.g., Tversky & Kahneman's scenarios) to LLMs to evaluate their outputs for specific human-like heuristics, including representativeness, insensitivity to sample size, base rate neglect, anchoring, and framing effects.
